title: harness: public OpenAI-compatible ingress with per-key budgets
goal: Turn the metering gateway into the general ingress: bearer keys map to budget accounts, /v1/models lists the registry, streaming and buffered completions keep the cache and ledger, per-key caps and rate limits, and a direct upstream mode that needs no LiteLLM. Prove a foreign client such as curl or OpenCode can use susi as its provider.
